Home / About Us

Building technology that moves possibilities forward.

Unisale Systems is a technology company focused on creating practical digital products, software solutions and automation systems that simplify processes and improve how people and businesses operate.

Who we are

Unisale Systems is built around a simple belief: technology should solve problems and create meaningful value.

We develop digital products and solutions with a focus on practicality, usability and innovation. Our goal is to transform ideas into useful technology that addresses real-world needs.

While our journey begins with products designed to improve business operations, our ambition extends much further. We aim to build technology that can make an impact across industries and markets.

Our Mission

To develop innovative, practical and accessible technology solutions that simplify processes, empower businesses and create meaningful value.

Our Vision

To become a globally recognised technology company known for building impactful digital products that transform how people work, operate businesses and interact with technology.

Our Values

Innovation

We continuously explore better ways to solve problems through technology.

Practicality

We focus on solutions that serve genuine needs and deliver meaningful value.

Excellence

We believe quality, reliability and attention to detail should guide everything we build.

Integrity

We value honesty, responsibility and transparency in our work.

Growth

We believe in continuous learning, improvement and building for the future.

Our Founder

Unisale Systems was founded by Collins Gitonga in October 2026. His passion for software development, technology and automation inspired the creation of a company focused on building useful digital products.

With a vision that extends beyond individual products, Unisale Systems represents a commitment to exploring how technology can make everyday processes better.
